text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2923

g.text: What the existing checkpoints say about a 22-minute limit

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526159

g.text: Latest eligible scored checkpoint across equivalent recipe records by 1,320 training seconds; steps can differ.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526159

g.text: Each dot is one training seed. Left-panel strokes show three-seed means at the available snapshots, not equal-step comparisons.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526159

g.text: Intermediate times use logged update timestamps; final times use measured trainer duration. No claim of an exact 22-minute score.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526159

g.text: Entropy uses timed-control reruns with identical actor digests (1,280–1,299s); these are the same policies, not extra independent seeds.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526159

g.text: Entropy and full horizon reached 24.99M steps within the limit for all 3 seeds; official and discount-only still mix checkpoint steps.
